title: Same-source hop + aggregate (PG·PG)
cypher: MATCH (po:PurchaseOrder)-[:ORDERED_FROM]->(s:Supplier) WHERE po.total_amount_usd > 50000 RETURN s.supplier_id AS a, count(po) AS b
compiled_sql:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('a', t.c0, 'b', t.c1) AS row FROM (
SELECT to_jsonb(n2.p_supplier_id) AS c0, count((jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('_id', n1.id, '_type', og_type_name(n1.type_id), 'buyer', to_jsonb(n1.p_buyer), 'contract_id', to_jsonb(n1.p_contract_id), 'order_date', to_jsonb(n1.p_order_date), 'po_id', to_jsonb(n1.p_po_id), 'priority', to_jsonb(n1.p_priority), 'promised_date', to_jsonb(n1.p_promised_date), 'status', to_jsonb(n1.p_status), 'supplier_id', to_jsonb(n1.p_supplier_id), 'total_amount_usd', to_jsonb(n1.p_total_amount_usd))) || COALESCE(n1.__ext,'{}'::jsonb))) AS c1 FROM og_data.v_3 n1
  CROSS JOIN og_data.v_1 n2
 WHERE n1.p_supplier_id = n2.p_supplier_id
   AND (n1.p_total_amount_usd > 50000)
 GROUP BY to_jsonb(n2.p_supplier_id)
) t
remote: SELECT r7.supplier_id, r5.po_id, r5.buyer, r5.contract_id, r5.order_date, r5.priority, r5.promised_date, r5.status, r5.supplier_id, r5.total_amount_usd FROM (erp.doc_purchase_order r5 INNER JOIN erp.mst_supplier r7 ON (((r5.supplier_id::text = r7.supplier_id::text)) AND ((r5.total_amount_usd::numeric > 50000::numeric))))
sql: SELECT s.supplier_id, count(*) FROM scm_erp.doc_purchase_order po JOIN scm_erp.mst_supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE po.total_amount_usd > 50000 GROUP BY s.supplier_id

title: Cross-source 2 hops (MySQL→PG→PG)

title: Branching pattern over CRM (MySQL) and ERP (PG)
cypher: MATCH (cu:Customer)<-[:PLACED_BY]-(so:SalesOrder)<-[:ABOUT_ORDER]-(c:Claim {severity:'HIGH'}), (so)-[:ORDERS_ITEM]->(i:Item) RETURN c.ticket_no AS a, cu.cust_name AS b, i.item_name AS c

SELECT to_jsonb(n3.p_ticket_no) AS c0, to_jsonb(n1.p_cust_name) AS c1, to_jsonb(n4.p_item_name) AS c2 FROM og_data.v_7 n1
  CROSS JOIN og_data.v_8 n2
  CROSS JOIN og_data.v_9 n3
  CROSS JOIN og_data.v_2 n4

title: Graph-only knowledge → virtual rows (native RiskEvent → Supplier ← Shipment)
cypher: MATCH (:Region {name:'East Asia'})<-[:IN_REGION]-(e:RiskEvent)-[:AFFECTS]->(s:Supplier)<-[:SHIPPED_BY]-(sh:Shipment) WHERE sh.ship_status <> 'DELIVERED' RETURN e.title AS a, sh.shipment_no AS b
compiled_sql:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('a', t.c0, 'b', t.c1) AS row FROM (
SELECT to_jsonb(n2.p_title) AS c0, to_jsonb(n6.p_shipment_no) AS c1 FROM og_data.v_21 n1
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT u.nbr, u.eid FROM og_data.og_adj adj3, LATERAL unnest(adj3.nbr, adj3.eid) AS u(nbr, eid) WHERE adj3.src = n1.id AND adj3.dir = 'i'::"char" AND adj3.etype = ANY(ARRAY[24]::int4[])) u4
  CROSS JOIN og_data.v_22 n2
  CROSS JOIN og_data.v_1 n5
  CROSS JOIN og_data.v_6 n6
 WHERE n1.p_name = 'East Asia'
   AND n2.id = u4.nbr
   AND n2.p_supplier_code = n5.p_supplier_id
   AND n6.p_vendor_code = n5.p_supplier_id
   AND (n6.p_ship_status <> 'DELIVERED')
) t
remote: SELECT `shipment_no`, `vendor_code` FROM `wms`.`shipment` WHERE ((`ship_status` <> 'DELIVERED')) ORDER BY `vendor_code` IS NULL, `vendor_code` ASC
sql: (two steps) MATCH (:Region {name:'East Asia'})<-[:IN_REGION]-(e:RiskEvent) RETURN e.title AS t, e.supplier_code AS k  ⟶  SELECT vendor_code, shipment_no FROM scm_wms.shipment WHERE ship_status <> 'DELIVERED' AND vendor_code IN ({keys})
